entries.3c5c22cabe85697f: It is the Group's core business, undertaken by DyDo DRINCO, Inc. and 11 sales companies. DyDo DRINCO plans and develops soft drinks, has beverage manufacturers outside the Group manufacture them on commission with containers and other materials supplied, and sells them to consumers through vending machines and storefronts such as convenience stores. Daido Yakuhin Kogyo also sells drink-type medicines that it manufactures in a business alliance with pharmaceutical companies through vending machines. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥142,532 million.
